"""design_F872 모델링 준비: 코호트·레이블·특징·분할 생성 (학습/성능 계산 없음)."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import GroupShuffleSplit

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
D = WS / "data"
OUT = WS / "prep"
design = json.loads((WS / "design_F872.json").read_text())

p = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
a = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
dx = pd.read_csv(D / "diagnoses.csv.gz")
labs = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
orders = pd.read_csv(D / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])

# tp = 퇴원 시각 (offset 0h)
a = a.sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"]).reset_index(drop=True)
a["tp"] = a["discharge_time"]

# outcome: 같은 환자의 다음 입원이 (tp, tp+30d] 안에 시작
a["next_admit"] = a.groupby("patient_id")["admit_time"].shift(-1)
gap = a["next_admit"] - a["tp"]
a["readmit_30d"] = ((gap > pd.Timedelta(0)) & (gap <= pd.Timedelta(days=30))).astype(int)

# 코호트
a = a.merge(p, on="patient_id", how="left")
n0 = len(a)
a = a[a["age"] >= 18]
n1 = len(a)
a = a[a["discharge_status"] != "died"].copy()
n2 = len(a)

# 특징
a["los_h"] = (a["discharge_time"] - a["admit_time"]).dt.total_seconds() / 3600
a["n_prior_adm"] = a.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()  # 퇴원 사망 입원 제외 전 순번이 필요하므로 아래에서 재계산
allad = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time"])
allad = allad.sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"])
allad["n_prior_adm"] = allad.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()
a["n_prior_adm"] = a["admission_id"].map(allad.set_index("admission_id")["n_prior_adm"])

# 진단: 해당 입원(admission_id)의 진단만 사용
dx["c3"] = dx["icd_code"].str[:3]
a["dx_ckd"] = a["admission_id"].isin(dx.loc[dx.c3 == "N18", "admission_id"]).astype(int)
a["dx_chf"] = a["admission_id"].isin(dx.loc[dx.c3 == "I50", "admission_id"]).astype(int)
a["n_dx"] = a["admission_id"].map(dx.groupby("admission_id").size()).fillna(0).astype(int)

# 검사: report_time 이 [admit, tp] 안인 결과만
lw = labs.merge(a[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]], on="admission_id")
lw = lw[(lw.report_time >= lw.admit_time) & (lw.report_time <= lw.tp)].sort_values("report_time")
a["hgb_min"] = a["admission_id"].map(lw[lw.test == "hemoglobin"].groupby("admission_id")["value"].min())
a["cr_last"] = a["admission_id"].map(lw[lw.test == "creatinine"].groupby("admission_id")["value"].last())

ow = orders.merge(a[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]], on="admission_id")
ow = ow[(ow.order_type == "dialysis_order") & (ow.order_time >= ow.admit_time) & (ow.order_time <= ow.tp)]
a["dialysis_ordered"] = a["admission_id"].isin(ow["admission_id"]).astype(int)

# 분할 (잠정): family_id 결측 시 patient_id 로 대체 — 설계 확인 필요
a["split_group"] = a["family_id"].fillna("PAT_" + a["patient_id"])
gss = GroupShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=design["split"]["test_fraction"],
                        random_state=design["split"]["seed"] % 2**32)
tr, te = next(gss.split(a, groups=a["split_group"]))
a["split"] = ""
a.iloc[tr, a.columns.get_loc("split")] = "train"
a.iloc[te, a.columns.get_loc("split")] = "test"

feats = [f["name"] for f in design["features"]]
cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "tp", "split", "readmit_30d"] + feats
a[cols].to_csv(OUT / "model_table.csv", index=False)

summary = {
    "n_admissions": n0, "after_adult": n1, "after_excl_died": n2,
    "n_patients": int(a.patient_id.nunique()),
    "family_id_missing_patients": int(p.family_id.isna().sum()),
    "outcome_rate": round(a.readmit_30d.mean(), 4),
    "split_counts": a.split.value_counts().to_dict(),
    "outcome_rate_by_split": a.groupby("split").readmit_30d.mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "group_overlap_train_test": int(len(set(a.loc[a.split == "train", "split_group"]) & set(a.loc[a.split == "test", "split_group"]))),
    "patient_overlap_train_test": int(len(set(a.loc[a.split == "train", "patient_id"]) & set(a.loc[a.split == "test", "patient_id"]))),
    "missing_rate": a[feats].isna().mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "labs_reported_after_discharge_excluded": int(((labs.merge(a[["admission_id","tp"]], on="admission_id")).eval("report_time > tp")).sum()),
}
(OUT / "prep_summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
EOF
